content_data.project_title: IoT Gateway Modernization for Smart Building Infrastructure
content_data.project_description: Migration of legacy IoT gateway systems to a cloud-native, mobile-first architecture supporting real-time sensor data aggregation and edge computing capabilities across regional smart building deployments.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1 (months 1-4) for architecture design and prototyping, Phase 2 (months 5-10) for core development, and Phase 3 (months 11-14) for deployment and optimization
content_data.project_lead: Priya Sundaram, Senior IoT Solutions Architect
objectives: Reduce gateway latency by 60% through edge computing implementation
Enable real-time mobile monitoring and control for 500+ connected devices per gateway
Achieve 99.9% uptime across regional deployment zones
deliverables: Automated deployment pipeline with CI/CD integration
Edge computing modules for local data processing
RESTful and GraphQL API documentation and SDK
Mobile-first dashboard application for iOS and Android
Training materials and knowledge transfer sessions
Security audit report and penetration testing results
Cloud-native IoT gateway platform with Kubernetes orchestration
content_data.risk_assessment: Medium-high risk due to complex integration with legacy building management systems, potential connectivity challenges across regional sites, and dependency on third-party IoT sensor manufacturers for protocol standardization.
